lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees. Required for location mode.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees. Required for location mode.

min_magnitude.description: Minimum reported magnitude, clamped to 1.0–9.9. Default: 5.0 (recent) or 3.0 (location).

mode.description: recent = global events sorted by time/magnitude; location = near a lat/lon coordinate. Default: recent.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km for location mode (10–1000). Default: 500.

ai.intuitek.stall/inputSchemaProjection.limitation: inputSchema is the existing runtime Zod projection. Canonical registry constraints are retained here; not_projected constraints are not enforced by that conversion. Structural changes and added schema metadata are reported separately. Declared contracts do not verify outcomes.

description: PAID MCP TOOL — $0.059 USDC per successful call via native x402. Discovery is free. Real-time earthquake intelligence from USGS. Fetch recent global significant quakes (M5.0+ last 7 days) or quakes near a lat/lon (M3.0+ within 500 km). Returns magnitude, depth, location, tsunami flag, and shake intensity. Free USGS FDSN API — no key required.
